agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason that the glory of the LORD fills the temple rather than leaves or passes it. The blank simply asks for the unseen verb in 2 Chronicles 7:1, making this a wording guess instead of a reasoned test of meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
